# Economic System Rework: Economic Race (generated by race_gui.py)

# Any scope, monthly, right after the world ranking.
won_race_sample = {
	add_to_variable = { global.won_hs_wait = 1 }
	if = {
		limit = {
			OR = {
				check_variable = { global.won_hs_n < 1 }
				check_variable = { var = global.won_hs_wait value = global.won_hs_step compare = greater_than_or_equals }
			}
		}
		set_variable = { global.won_hs_wait = 0 }
		if = {
			limit = { check_variable = { global.won_hs_n < 1 } }
			set_variable = { global.won_hs_step = 1 }
			set_variable = { global.won_hs_y0 = global.year }
		}
		# Full: keep every second sample and sample half as often from now on
		if = {
			limit = { check_variable = { global.won_hs_n > 29 } }
			every_country = {
				limit = { exists = yes has_country_flag = won_ready }
				won_race_halve = yes
			}
			multiply_variable = { global.won_hs_step = 2 }
			set_variable = { global.won_hs_n = 15 }
		}
		every_country = {
			limit = { exists = yes has_country_flag = won_ready }
			won_race_push = yes
		}
		add_to_variable = { global.won_hs_n = 1 }
	}
}

# Country scope: one new sample of GDP and, for faction leaders, faction GDP.
won_race_push = {
	if = {
		limit = { check_variable = { var = won_hg^num value = global.won_hs_n compare = greater_than } }
		clear_array = won_hg
		clear_array = won_hf
	}
	# Countries that appeared later have no earlier history
	while_loop_effect = {
		limit = { check_variable = { var = won_hg^num value = global.won_hs_n compare = less_than } }
		add_to_array = { won_hg = 0 }
		add_to_array = { won_hf = 0 }
	}
	add_to_array = { won_hg = won_gdp }
	set_temp_variable = { won_t = 0 }
	if = {
		limit = { is_faction_leader = yes }
		set_temp_variable = { won_t = won_fac_gdp }
	}
	add_to_array = { won_hf = won_t }
}

won_race_halve = {
	clear_array = won_tmp_h
	for_each_loop = {
		array = won_hg
		value = won_v
		index = won_i
		set_temp_variable = { won_m2 = won_i }
		modulo_temp_variable = { won_m2 = 2 }
		if = {
			limit = { check_variable = { won_m2 = 0 } }
			add_to_array = { won_tmp_h = won_v }
		}
	}
	clear_array = won_hg
	for_each_loop = { array = won_tmp_h value = won_v add_to_array = { won_hg = won_v } }
	clear_array = won_tmp_h
	for_each_loop = {
		array = won_hf
		value = won_v
		index = won_i
		set_temp_variable = { won_m2 = won_i }
		modulo_temp_variable = { won_m2 = 2 }
		if = {
			limit = { check_variable = { won_m2 = 0 } }
			add_to_array = { won_tmp_h = won_v }
		}
	}
	clear_array = won_hf
	for_each_loop = { array = won_tmp_h value = won_v add_to_array = { won_hf = won_v } }
	clear_array = won_tmp_h
}

# Opens the chart (ROOT = the player).
won_race_open = {
	clr_country_flag = won_show_dash
	clr_country_flag = won_show_league
	set_country_flag = won_show_race
	if = {
		limit = { NOT = { has_variable = won_rc_mode } }
		set_variable = { won_rc_mode = 1 }
	}
	if = {
		limit = { check_variable = { won_rank_gdp < 1 } }
		won_world_rank = yes
	}
	if = {
		limit = { check_variable = { global.won_hs_n < 1 } }
		won_race_sample = yes
	}
	won_race_show = yes
}

# Temp won_a, won_b (two neighbouring values) -> temp won_rf (frame), won_ry (height of the icon).
won_rc_seg = {
	set_temp_variable = { won_y0 = won_a }
	divide_temp_variable = { won_y0 = won_rc_max }
	multiply_temp_variable = { won_y0 = -340 }
	add_to_temp_variable = { won_y0 = 340 }
	set_temp_variable = { won_y1 = won_b }
	divide_temp_variable = { won_y1 = won_rc_max }
	multiply_temp_variable = { won_y1 = -340 }
	add_to_temp_variable = { won_y1 = 340 }
	set_temp_variable = { won_rf = won_y1 }
	subtract_from_temp_variable = { won_rf = won_y0 }
	divide_temp_variable = { won_rf = 3 }
	round_temp_variable = won_rf
	clamp_temp_variable = { var = won_rf min = -24 max = 24 }
	add_to_temp_variable = { won_rf = 26 }
	set_temp_variable = { won_ry = won_y0 }
	add_to_temp_variable = { won_ry = won_y1 }
	divide_temp_variable = { won_ry = 2 }
	subtract_from_temp_variable = { won_ry = 76 }
}

# Recalculates the chart. Only runs while the window is open.
won_race_show = {
	set_temp_variable = { won_m = 1 }
	set_variable = { won_rc_on0 = 0 }
	set_variable = { won_rc_kf0 = 1 }
	clear_array = won_rc_a0
	if = {
		limit = { check_variable = { won_rc_mode = 1 } check_variable = { global.won_rk_gdp_v0 > 0 } }
		set_variable = { won_rc_c0 = global.won_rk_gdp_c0 }
		set_variable = { won_rc_v0 = global.won_rk_gdp_v0 }
		set_variable = { won_rc_on0 = 1 }
		set_variable = { won_rc_kf0 = 2 }
	}
	if = {
		limit = { check_variable = { won_rc_mode = 2 } check_variable = { global.won_rk_fac_v0 > 0 } }
		set_variable = { won_rc_c0 = global.won_rk_fac_c0 }
		set_variable = { won_rc_v0 = global.won_rk_fac_v0 }
		set_variable = { won_rc_on0 = 1 }
		set_variable = { won_rc_kf0 = 2 }
	}
	if = {
		limit = { check_variable = { won_rc_on0 = 1 } }
		var:won_rc_c0 = {
			if = {
				limit = { ROOT = { check_variable = { won_rc_mode = 2 } } }
				for_each_loop = { array = won_hf value = won_v ROOT = { add_to_array = { won_rc_a0 = won_v } } }
			}
			else = {
				for_each_loop = { array = won_hg value = won_v ROOT = { add_to_array = { won_rc_a0 = won_v } } }
			}
		}
		set_temp_variable = { won_first = 0 }
		for_each_loop = {
			array = won_rc_a0
			value = won_v
			if = { limit = { check_variable = { var = won_v value = won_m compare = greater_than } } set_temp_variable = { won_m = won_v } }
			if = { limit = { check_variable = { won_first = 0 } check_variable = { won_v > 0 } } set_temp_variable = { won_first = won_v } }
		}
		if = { limit = { check_variable = { var = won_rc_v0 value = won_m compare = greater_than } } set_temp_variable = { won_m = won_rc_v0 } }
		set_variable = { won_rc_pct0 = 0 }
		if = {
			limit = { check_variable = { won_first > 0 } }
			set_variable = { won_rc_pct0 = won_rc_v0 }
			divide_variable = { won_rc_pct0 = won_first }
			subtract_from_variable = { won_rc_pct0 = 1 }
			multiply_variable = { won_rc_pct0 = 100 }
		}
	}
	set_variable = { won_rc_on1 = 0 }
	set_variable = { won_rc_kf1 = 1 }
	clear_array = won_rc_a1
	if = {
		limit = { check_variable = { won_rc_mode = 1 } check_variable = { global.won_rk_gdp_v1 > 0 } }
		set_variable = { won_rc_c1 = global.won_rk_gdp_c1 }
		set_variable = { won_rc_v1 = global.won_rk_gdp_v1 }
		set_variable = { won_rc_on1 = 1 }
		set_variable = { won_rc_kf1 = 3 }
	}
	if = {
		limit = { check_variable = { won_rc_mode = 2 } check_variable = { global.won_rk_fac_v1 > 0 } }
		set_variable = { won_rc_c1 = global.won_rk_fac_c1 }
		set_variable = { won_rc_v1 = global.won_rk_fac_v1 }
		set_variable = { won_rc_on1 = 1 }
		set_variable = { won_rc_kf1 = 3 }
	}
	if = {
		limit = { check_variable = { won_rc_on1 = 1 } }
		var:won_rc_c1 = {
			if = {
				limit = { ROOT = { check_variable = { won_rc_mode = 2 } } }
				for_each_loop = { array = won_hf value = won_v ROOT = { add_to_array = { won_rc_a1 = won_v } } }
			}
			else = {
				for_each_loop = { array = won_hg value = won_v ROOT = { add_to_array = { won_rc_a1 = won_v } } }
			}
		}
		set_temp_variable = { won_first = 0 }
		for_each_loop = {
			array = won_rc_a1
			value = won_v
			if = { limit = { check_variable = { var = won_v value = won_m compare = greater_than } } set_temp_variable = { won_m = won_v } }
			if = { limit = { check_variable = { won_first = 0 } check_variable = { won_v > 0 } } set_temp_variable = { won_first = won_v } }
		}
		if = { limit = { check_variable = { var = won_rc_v1 value = won_m compare = greater_than } } set_temp_variable = { won_m = won_rc_v1 } }
		set_variable = { won_rc_pct1 = 0 }
		if = {
			limit = { check_variable = { won_first > 0 } }
			set_variable = { won_rc_pct1 = won_rc_v1 }
			divide_variable = { won_rc_pct1 = won_first }
			subtract_from_variable = { won_rc_pct1 = 1 }
			multiply_variable = { won_rc_pct1 = 100 }
		}
	}
	set_variable = { won_rc_on2 = 0 }
	set_variable = { won_rc_kf2 = 1 }
	clear_array = won_rc_a2
	if = {
		limit = { check_variable = { won_rc_mode = 1 } check_variable = { global.won_rk_gdp_v2 > 0 } }
		set_variable = { won_rc_c2 = global.won_rk_gdp_c2 }
		set_variable = { won_rc_v2 = global.won_rk_gdp_v2 }
		set_variable = { won_rc_on2 = 1 }
		set_variable = { won_rc_kf2 = 4 }
	}
	if = {
		limit = { check_variable = { won_rc_mode = 2 } check_variable = { global.won_rk_fac_v2 > 0 } }
		set_variable = { won_rc_c2 = global.won_rk_fac_c2 }
		set_variable = { won_rc_v2 = global.won_rk_fac_v2 }
		set_variable = { won_rc_on2 = 1 }
		set_variable = { won_rc_kf2 = 4 }
	}
	if = {
		limit = { check_variable = { won_rc_on2 = 1 } }
		var:won_rc_c2 = {
			if = {
				limit = { ROOT = { check_variable = { won_rc_mode = 2 } } }
				for_each_loop = { array = won_hf value = won_v ROOT = { add_to_array = { won_rc_a2 = won_v } } }
			}
			else = {
				for_each_loop = { array = won_hg value = won_v ROOT = { add_to_array = { won_rc_a2 = won_v } } }
			}
		}
		set_temp_variable = { won_first = 0 }
		for_each_loop = {
			array = won_rc_a2
			value = won_v
			if = { limit = { check_variable = { var = won_v value = won_m compare = greater_than } } set_temp_variable = { won_m = won_v } }
			if = { limit = { check_variable = { won_first = 0 } check_variable = { won_v > 0 } } set_temp_variable = { won_first = won_v } }
		}
		if = { limit = { check_variable = { var = won_rc_v2 value = won_m compare = greater_than } } set_temp_variable = { won_m = won_rc_v2 } }
		set_variable = { won_rc_pct2 = 0 }
		if = {
			limit = { check_variable = { won_first > 0 } }
			set_variable = { won_rc_pct2 = won_rc_v2 }
			divide_variable = { won_rc_pct2 = won_first }
			subtract_from_variable = { won_rc_pct2 = 1 }
			multiply_variable = { won_rc_pct2 = 100 }
		}
	}
	set_variable = { won_rc_on3 = 0 }
	set_variable = { won_rc_kf3 = 1 }
	clear_array = won_rc_a3
	if = {
		limit = { check_variable = { won_rc_mode = 1 } check_variable = { global.won_rk_gdp_v3 > 0 } }
		set_variable = { won_rc_c3 = global.won_rk_gdp_c3 }
		set_variable = { won_rc_v3 = global.won_rk_gdp_v3 }
		set_variable = { won_rc_on3 = 1 }
		set_variable = { won_rc_kf3 = 5 }
	}
	if = {
		limit = { check_variable = { won_rc_mode = 2 } check_variable = { global.won_rk_fac_v3 > 0 } }
		set_variable = { won_rc_c3 = global.won_rk_fac_c3 }
		set_variable = { won_rc_v3 = global.won_rk_fac_v3 }
		set_variable = { won_rc_on3 = 1 }
		set_variable = { won_rc_kf3 = 5 }
	}
	if = {
		limit = { check_variable = { won_rc_on3 = 1 } }
		var:won_rc_c3 = {
			if = {
				limit = { ROOT = { check_variable = { won_rc_mode = 2 } } }
				for_each_loop = { array = won_hf value = won_v ROOT = { add_to_array = { won_rc_a3 = won_v } } }
			}
			else = {
				for_each_loop = { array = won_hg value = won_v ROOT = { add_to_array = { won_rc_a3 = won_v } } }
			}
		}
		set_temp_variable = { won_first = 0 }
		for_each_loop = {
			array = won_rc_a3
			value = won_v
			if = { limit = { check_variable = { var = won_v value = won_m compare = greater_than } } set_temp_variable = { won_m = won_v } }
			if = { limit = { check_variable = { won_first = 0 } check_variable = { won_v > 0 } } set_temp_variable = { won_first = won_v } }
		}
		if = { limit = { check_variable = { var = won_rc_v3 value = won_m compare = greater_than } } set_temp_variable = { won_m = won_rc_v3 } }
		set_variable = { won_rc_pct3 = 0 }
		if = {
			limit = { check_variable = { won_first > 0 } }
			set_variable = { won_rc_pct3 = won_rc_v3 }
			divide_variable = { won_rc_pct3 = won_first }
			subtract_from_variable = { won_rc_pct3 = 1 }
			multiply_variable = { won_rc_pct3 = 100 }
		}
	}
	set_variable = { won_rc_on4 = 0 }
	set_variable = { won_rc_kf4 = 1 }
	clear_array = won_rc_a4
	if = {
		limit = { check_variable = { won_rc_mode = 1 } check_variable = { global.won_rk_gdp_v4 > 0 } }
		set_variable = { won_rc_c4 = global.won_rk_gdp_c4 }

		limit = { check_variable = { won_rc_mode = 2 } check_variable = { global.won_rk_fac_v4 > 0 } }

		set_variable = { won_rc_on4 = 1 }

	if = {
		limit = { check_variable = { won_rc_on4 = 1 } }
		var:won_rc_c4 = {
			if = {
				limit = { ROOT = { check_variable = { won_rc_mode = 2 } } }
				for_each_loop = { array = won_hf value = won_v ROOT = { add_to_array = { won_rc_a4 = won_v } } }
			}
			else = {
				for_each_loop = { array = won_hg value = won_v ROOT = { add_to_array = { won_rc_a4 = won_v } } }
			}
		}
		set_temp_variable = { won_first = 0 }
		for_each_loop = {
			array = won_rc_a4
			value = won_v
			if = { limit = { check_variable = { var = won_v value = won_m compare = greater_than } } set_temp_variable = { won_m = won_v } }
			if = { limit = { check_variable = { won_first = 0 } check_variable = { won_v > 0 } } set_temp_variable = { won_first = won_v } }
		}
		if = { limit = { check_variable = { var = won_rc_v4 value = won_m compare = greater_than } } set_temp_variable = { won_m = won_rc_v4 } }
		set_variable = { won_rc_pct4 = 0 }
		if = {
			limit = { check_variable = { won_first > 0 } }
			set_variable = { won_rc_pct4 = won_rc_v4 }
			divide_variable = { won_rc_pct4 = won_first }
			subtract_from_variable = { won_rc_pct4 = 1 }
			multiply_variable = { won_rc_pct4 = 100 }
		}
	}
	set_variable = { won_rc_max = won_m }
	multiply_variable = { won_rc_max = 1.05 }
	set_variable = { won_rc_t0 = won_rc_max }
	multiply_variable = { won_rc_t0 = 1.0 }
	set_variable = { won_rc_t1 = won_rc_max }
	multiply_variable = { won_rc_t1 = 0.75 }
	set_variable = { won_rc_t2 = won_rc_max }
	multiply_variable = { won_rc_t2 = 0.5 }
	set_variable = { won_rc_t3 = won_rc_max }
	multiply_variable = { won_rc_t3 = 0.25 }
	set_variable = { won_rc_t4 = won_rc_max }
	multiply_variable = { won_rc_t4 = 0.0 }
	set_variable = { won_rc_x0 = 0 }
	set_variable = { won_rc_x1 = 20 }
	set_variable = { won_rc_x2 = 40 }
	set_variable = { won_rc_x3 = 60 }
	set_variable = { won_rc_x4 = 80 }
	set_variable = { won_rc_x5 = 100 }
	set_variable = { won_rc_x6 = 120 }
	set_variable = { won_rc_x7 = 140 }
	set_variable = { won_rc_x8 = 160 }
	set_variable = { won_rc_x9 = 180 }
	set_variable = { won_rc_x10 = 200 }
	set_variable = { won_rc_x11 = 220 }
	set_variable = { won_rc_x12 = 240 }
	set_variable = { won_rc_x13 = 260 }
	set_variable = { won_rc_x14 = 280 }
	set_variable = { won_rc_x15 = 300 }
	set_variable = { won_rc_x16 = 320 }
	set_variable = { won_rc_x17 = 340 }
	set_variable = { won_rc_x18 = 360 }
	set_variable = { won_rc_x19 = 380 }
	set_variable = { won_rc_x20 = 400 }
	set_variable = { won_rc_x21 = 420 }
	set_variable = { won_rc_x22 = 440 }
	set_variable = { won_rc_x23 = 460 }
	set_variable = { won_rc_x24 = 480 }
	set_variable = { won_rc_x25 = 500 }
	set_variable = { won_rc_x26 = 520 }
	set_variable = { won_rc_x27 = 540 }
	set_variable = { won_rc_x28 = 560 }
	set_variable = { won_rc_f0_0 = 1 }
	set_variable = { won_rc_y0_0 = 0 }
	if = {
		limit = { check_variable = { won_rc_on0 = 1 } check_variable = { global.won_hs_n > 1 } check_variable = { won_rc_a0^0 > 0 } check_variable = { won_rc_a0^1 > 0 } }
		set_temp_variable = { won_a = won_rc_a0^0 }
		set_temp_variable = { won_b = won_rc_a0^1 }
		won_rc_seg = yes
		set_variable = { won_rc_f0_0 = won_rf }
		set_variable = { won_rc_y0_0 = won_ry }
	}
	set_variable = { won_rc_f0_1 = 1 }
	set_variable = { won_rc_y0_1 = 0 }
	if = {
		limit = { check_variable = { won_rc_on0 = 1 } check_variable = { global.won_hs_n > 2 } check_variable = { won_rc_a0^1 > 0 } check_variable = { won_rc_a0^2 > 0 } }
		set_temp_variable = { won_a = won_rc_a0^1 }
		set_temp_variable = { won_b = won_rc_a0^2 }
		won_rc_seg = yes
		set_variable = { won_rc_f0_1 = won_rf }
		set_variable = { won_rc_y0_1 = won_ry }
	}
	set_variable = { won_rc_f0_2 = 1 }
	set_variable = { won_rc_y0_2 = 0 }
	if = {
		limit = { check_variable = { won_rc_on0 = 1 } check_variable = { global.won_hs_n > 3 } check_variable = { won_rc_a0^2 > 0 } check_variable = { won_rc_a0^3 > 0 } }
		set_temp_variable = { won_a = won_rc_a0^2 }
		set_temp_variable = { won_b = won_rc_a0^3 }
		won_rc_seg = yes
		set_variable = { won_rc_f0_2 = won_rf }
		set_variable = { won_rc_y0_2 = won_ry }
	}
	set_variable = { won_rc_f0_3 = 1 }
	set_variable = { won_rc_y0_3 = 0 }
	if = {
		limit = { check_variable = { won_rc_on0 = 1 } check_variable = { global.won_hs_n > 4 } check_variable = { won_rc_a0^3 > 0 } check_variable = { won_rc_a0^4 > 0 } }
		set_temp_variable = { won_a = won_rc_a0^3 }
		set_temp_variable = { won_b = won_rc_a0^4 }
		won_rc_seg = yes
		set_variable = { won_rc_f0_3 = won_rf }
		set_variable = { won_rc_y0_3 = won_ry }
	}
	set_variable = { won_rc_f0_4 = 1 }
	set_variable = { won_rc_y0_4 = 0 }
	if = {
		limit = { check_variable = { won_rc_on0 = 1 } check_variable = { global.won_hs_n > 5 } check_variable = { won_rc_a0^4 > 0 } check_variable = { won_rc_a0^5 > 0 } }
		set_temp_variable = { won_a = won_rc_a0^4 }
		set_temp_variable = { won_b = won_rc_a0^5 }
		won_rc_seg = yes
		set_variable = { won_rc_f0_4 = won_rf }
		set_variable = { won_rc_y0_4 = won_ry }
	}
	set_variable = { won_rc_f0_5 = 1 }
	set_variable = { won_rc_y0_5 = 0 }
	if = {
		limit = { check_variable = { won_rc_on0 = 1 } check_variable = { global.won_hs_n > 6 } check_variable = { won_rc_a0^5 > 0 } check_variable = { won_rc_a0^6 > 0 } }
		set_temp_variable = { won_a = won_rc_a0^5 }
		set_temp_variable = { won_b = won_rc_a0^6 }
		won_rc_seg = yes
		set_variable = { won_rc_f0_5 = won_rf }
